Everyone is fighting for their piece of the galaxy.|[[Kay Vess]]|''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''}} The '''Outer Rim Territories''', also known as the '''Outer Rim''', '''Outer Systems''', or simply the '''Rim''', was a sparsely populated region of [[the galaxy]] located outside the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] before [[Wild Space]] and the [[Unknown Regions]]. The largest region in the [[galaxy]], it was home to diverse [[Planet|worlds]] and rugged, primitive frontier planets. A region that often went without a major faction holding control over it, the Outer Rim was a home to [[pirate]]s, [[smuggler]]s, [[enslaver]]s, and other criminals throughout the [[timeline of galactic history]]. The [[Galactic Republic]] expanded into the Outer Rim throughout its [[Republic Era|era of governance]], making major progress during the so-called [[High Republic Era]], only for dangers like the [[Nihil]] marauders and [[Drengir crisis]] to hinder the expansion efforts. Inequalities between the richer [[Core Worlds]] and the poorer Outer Rim Territories set the stage for resentments that fed several conflicts through the history of the galaxy, including the [[Clone Wars]] as well as the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Later, the Outer Rim became a major theater of conflict during the [[Cold War]] and ensuing [[First Order-Resistance War]]. ==History== {{Quote|How did you end up here in the Outer Rim?|[[Anakin Skywalker]]|{{Film|I}}}} ===Days of the Old Republic=== {{Quote|The Republic doesn't exist out here… We must survive on our own.|[[Shmi Skywalker Lars|Shmi Skywalker]]|}} [[File:Valley_of_the_Dark_Lords_TCW.png|thumb|left|300px|The Valley of the Dark Lords on the Sith homeworld of Moraband]] With the formation of the [[Galactic Republic]] and the bustling [[Core Worlds|Core]] [[planet]] of [[Coruscant]] being [[homeworld]] to the pioneering [[human]] [[species]], [[The galaxy|galactic]] expansion occurred along trailblazing new [[hyperspace route]]s emanating outwards from the Core Worlds, with [[colonist]]s heading towards the Outer Rim in search of opportunities and a better life.''[[Smuggler's Run: A Han Solo & Chewbacca Adventure]]'' Owing to economic and legal restrictions, coupled with [[Politics|political]] repression, many chose to live beyond the civilizing grasp of the Core. [[Navigational beacon]]s set up by Republic survey teams such as in the [[Tertiary Usaita system]] aided travelers heading towards the [[Galaxy|galactic]] periphery.''[[The Weapon of a Jedi: A Luke Skywalker Adventure]]'' Located on the Coreward edge of the Outer Rim, the planet of [[Anaxes]] helped to protect the Core Worlds from attack.''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' Eventually, tensions arose between the Republic and its Jedi allies over the warrior culture of the Outer Rim world of [[Mandalore]], leading to a [[Mandalorian-Jedi War|destructive conflict]] that ultimately saw the theft of the [[Darksaber]] from the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]].{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}} While the [[Sith]] eventually collapsed from continuous infighting, [[Darth Bane]] secretly survived and enacted the [[Rule of Two]], while he and other [[Sith Lord]]s were buried in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Moraband]].{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}} ===Republic Era=== ====Height of the Republic==== =====Expansion and its troubles===== The Galactic Republic remained one of the dominant galactic powers of the [[millennium]]. Though eventually trade and galactic commerce boomed between the Core and Outer Rim Territories, the Outer Rim was difficult to navigate and dangerous during the [[High Republic Era]].[[Star Wars (2020) 2|''Star Wars'' (2020) 2]] A [[Great Hyperspace Rush|rush]] for new hyperspace routes erupted, with both private parties and the Republic itself looking for new lanes. At the same time, the planets of [[Eiram]] and [[E'ronoh]] were caught in a [[Eiram and E'ronoh War|forever war]]''[[The High Republic: Path of Deceit]]'' that brought strife to the Outer Rim;''[[The High Republic: The Battle of Jedha]]'' refugees fled across the [[Eiram system]]'s side of the Rim while food and fuel shortages impacted the entire region. In venturing into the Rim to help the Republic's expansion, the [[Jedi Order]] also hoped to meet new communities and introduce itself as a group they could approach for help. Its exploration, however, brought the Jedi [[Mission to Dalna (Macri and Zink)|into contact]] with the [[Path of the Open Hand]] cult on the planet [[Dalna]], which saw the [[Great Leveler]] unleashed against the Jedi. [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Orlen Mollo]], having come from the Rim, better understood its troubles and cultures than fellow [[Chancellor]] [[Kyong Greylark]] and thus traveled across it, providing on-the-ground aid while Greylark remained with the [[Galactic Senate]] on Coruscant. Despite the Jedi Order and Mollo's united efforts to create a peace between both planets,''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]'' the [[Battle of Jedha]] brought about the collapse of the Eiram-E'ronoh peace effort.[[The High Republic (2022) 6|''The High Republic'' (2022) 6]] The rivalry between the two worlds would not be settled until the [[Eiram–E'ronoh crisis]].''[[The High Republic: Into the Dark]]'' Later, Supreme Chancellor [[Lina Soh]] sought to bring the outer worlds into the Republic''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' like Mollo and Greylark before her. To accomplish her goals, she established [[outreach program]]s. She also requested the Jedi Order expand its outreach as well, and [[Senator]] [[Izzet Noor]] of [[Serenno]] voiced the needs of the majority of the Outer Rim in the [[Galactic Senate]]. Traveling to the Outer Rim through [[hyperspace]] aboard transport ships like the ''[[Legacy Run]]'', many settlers left the overpopulated Core and [[Colonies]] to make new lives for themselves, hoping to earn [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] and make a future. Part of the Outer Rim became known as the [[Galactic Frontier]], which was also home to a guiding station known as [[Starlight Beacon]]. Even as Starlight was being constructed, the Outer Rim was considered a place of challenges; these challenges proved to be more deadly than exciting. Republic [[Judicial Forces]] and the Jedi Order enforced order throughout the galaxy, preventing a major galactic war for [[Standard century|centuries]]. During the High Republic Era, the [[Republic Defense Coalition]] also helped patrol the Rim. =====Rise of the Nihil===== {{Quote|Let them try their best. They'll beg for help, they'll turn to Corellia, they'll look high and low for solutions. But we've blocked them at every turn. They won't be able to prevent the full, complete destruction of Starlight Beacon. After that, none will be able to deny that the Nihil are the true masters of the Outer Rim.|Marchion Ro during the destruction of Starlight Beacon|''[[The High Republic: The Fallen Star]]''}} Following the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]], the Outer Rim was effected by the [[Emergences]], forcing Soh to [[blockade]] hyperspace routes into the Rim, which impacted many worlds in the region. She did not end the blockade until the [[Nihil]] were assumed defeated in the [[Battle of Kur]]. Led by the [[Eye of the Nihil]] [[Marchion Ro]], the Nihil opposed the expanding Republic, seeing themselves as being truly free. After their assumed defeat, the Nihil began to launch their raids on a galaxy-wide scale, instead of simply remaining in the Outer Rim. At the same time, the Republic was faced with the [[Drengir crisis]], in which the [[Drengir]] species began to spread and destroy everything in their path.''[[The High Republic: Race to Crashpoint Tower]]'' After the [[destruction of Starlight Beacon]] and with the [[deployment of the stormseeds]], Ro declared[[The High Republic: Eye of the Storm 2|''The High Republic: Eye of the Storm'' 2]] ten sectors of the Outer Rim to be under Nihil control,''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: Chronicles of the Jedi]]'' forming the [[Occlusion Zone]]{{HighRepublicShow|f0l-OuG3BVg|High Republic Phase II Deep Dive, Star Wars Celebration, and More!|sw_url=video/high-republic-phase-ii-deep-dive-star-wars-celebration-and-more}} he called "Nihil space." The conflict came to its end with the [[Battle of Eriadu]] and [[Mission to Planet X (Jedi Order)|mission to Planet X]]''[[The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi]]'' of [[228 BBY]]{{TrialsoftheJediDate}} while the High Republic Era itself came to a close around [[100 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' ====Fall of the Republic==== {{Quote|This, from the days when the Separatists brought the war to the Outer Rim in the later years of the Clone Wars.|Norra Wexley, while visiting the droid factory on Akiva|[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]}}
[[File:Battle_of_Geonosis.png|thumb|300px|The Battle of Geonosis rages.]]
Several years before the [[Clone Wars]], those in the Outer Rim eventually came to believe themselves victims of economic and social injustices, as [[Judicial]]s were often withheld in intervening in Outer Rim affairs after many far-flung worlds refused to provide the Core with profitable deals. Harassed by numerous [[pirate]]s and lacking protection from a federal military, the Outer Rim world of [[Eriadu]] formed the [[Outland Regions Security Force]] for the protection of the [[Seswenna sector]]. Funded by off-world loans and composed of an amalgam of [[Starship|ships]], it received weapons from arms [[merchant]]s who had for centuries been ignoring a Republic ban on the sale of weapons to member worlds. Initially lacking major success, it came to the forefront after [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] joined its [[Outland's anti-pirate taskforce|anti-piracy task force]], in which he was able to significantly reduce pirate raids throughout neighboring systems. With the monolithic [[Trade Federation]] slowly encroaching on the Outer Rim and the perceived weakness of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]], who was already embroiled in numerous scandals and unable to bring the growing corruption in the Galactic Senate under control, [[Governor]] Tarkin [[Governor of Eriadu|of Eriadu]] turned Valorum from investigating a [[Eriadu Conference|trade summit]] in an effort to weaken his authority. Ending in a disaster, the summit hastened the Trade Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo]] over the recently proposed taxation of the [[Free Trade Zone]]s and disputes over [[plasma]] exports. With increasing dissatisfaction over years of neglect from the Core Worlds, dashing political idealist [[Count]] [[Dooku]] managed to foment political turmoil on worlds such as [[Kashyyyk]], [[Sullust]] and [[Onderon]]. He eventually hijacked a [[HoloNet News|HoloNet]] station in the [[Raxus system]] to voice his opinion. This precipitated the [[Separatist Crisis]], which would see thousands of worlds leave the Galactic Republic and join the growing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[File:Tarkin-Battle_of_Murkhana.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Republic and Separatists made advances throughout the Outer Rim, making it a battlefront for clones and droids.]] After the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], the deadly three-year Clone Wars engulfed the galaxy and resulted in billions dead on both sides of the conflict. The Republic was forced to raise the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] to combat the Separatist threat, with the war grounding on until the [[Outer Rim Sieges]]. At one time during the sieges, the Separatists [[Battle of Anaxes|invaded]] Anaxes, which hosted a [[Anaxes shipyards|major shipyard]] for the Republic [[Navy]].{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} Later, Skywalker, the [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], and the elite [[Clone Force 99]] discovered that the [[Techno Union]] [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]] was using the captured [[clone trooper]] [[Echo]] to unconsciously provide strategies to the Separatist [[commander]] [[Admiral]] [[Trench]].{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} After [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|rescuing]] Echo, Skywalker and the [[Cloning|clones]] devised a successful counter-strategy which led to the defeat of [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] on Anaxes. The victory allowed Anaxes to continue to produce warships for the Republic war effort.{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}} The war continued until the [[death]] of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] [[Mission to Mustafar|on]] [[Mustafar]]. Meanwhile, Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire|First Galactic Empire]], wiping away the thousand-year-old [[democracy]]—and the [[Order 66|Jedi Order]]—in an instant.{{Film|III}} ===Age of the Empire=== {{Quote|The factor that contributed most to the demise of the Republic was not, in fact, the war, but rampant self-interest. Endemic to the political process our ancestors engineered, the insidious pursuit of self-enrichment grew only more pervasive through the long centuries, and in the end left the body politic feckless and corrupt. Consider the self-interest of the Core Worlds, unwavering in their exploitation of the Outer Systems for resources; the Outer Systems themselves, undermined by their permissive disregard of smuggling and slavery; those ambitious members of the Senate who sought only status and opportunity.|Wilhuff Tarkin, regarding the fall of the Galactic Republic and rise of the First Galactic Empire|[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']]}} [[File:FettCrashesCantina-2015StarWars5.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Outer Rim was home to [[bounty hunter]]s and [[smuggler]]s]] The budding Galactic Empire increasingly attempted to take control of the Outer Rim, although many worlds never fully fell under the Empire's sway, and were instead controlled by unsavory criminal organizations like the [[Hutt Clan|Hutt Cartel]], the [[Pyke Syndicate]], the [[Black Sun]], or [[Zygerrian]] [[Slavery|slavers]].''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' Believing control of the galaxy's outer systems would stabilize and secure the galactic center, [[Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine oversaw the buildup of the [[Imperial Military]] and ruthless quashing of dissent and remaining [[Separatist holdouts]] across the Outer Rim. Worlds such as [[Jelucan]] and [[Lothal]] saw Imperial occupation and development, often leading to rampant pollution and industrialization to support the Imperial war machine, while men and women were conscripted into the [[Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy|Navy]]. A "five-year plan" was implemented for numerous Imperial-occupied worlds under the supervision of the [[Imperial Outer Rim High Command]].''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]''{{Rebels|Empire Day (episode)}} In the farthest reaches of the Outer Rim, the Empire barely bothered to patrol its territory, and local citizens' militias took it upon themselves to protect friendly [[convoy]]s. The Empire was never able to fully control the Outer Rim, but often utilized its worlds as testing grounds for new biological weapons and as a source of labor, brutally [[Siege of Lasan|wiping]] out the [[Lasat]] species of the Outer Rim world of [[Lasan]], exploiting the native [[Twi'lek]] species of [[Ryloth]] by rounding up native villagers for slave labor,''[[Lords of the Sith]]'' and murdering nearly all the [[Geonosian]]s.{{Rebels|Ghosts of Geonosis}} Seeking to embody the spirit of the [[Tarkin Doctrine]], the Empire oversaw the construction of the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] over [[Geonosis]] and [[Sterilization of Geonosis|exterminated]] the native Geonosian population.[[Darth Vader (2015) 4|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 4]] [[Grand Moff]] Tarkin was tasked with imposing order in the Outer Rim Territories, being promoted to Governor of the Outer Rim.''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' After limiting the HoloNet of various Outer Rim worlds to Imperial use five years after the formation of the [[New Order]], many dissatisfied systems viewed the embargo as the unofficial start of the Imperial conquest of the Outer Systems. The Empire also engaged in a brutal taxation in the Outer Rim regions{{Kenobi|Part I}} as of [[9 BBY]].{{KenobiDate|I}} Overall, the Empire, during its reign, attempted to extract whatever wealth existed at the edges of the galaxy and shift it towards the Core Worlds''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' through oppressive taxation, destructive mining,{{Rebels|The Occupation}} and outright pillaging.{{Rebels|Hera's Heroes}} Such wealth was used to uplift the Imperial project, such as by furthering the construction of the Imperial Military, or used to keep the galaxy's rulers and wealthy comfortable. In [[10 BBY]],The timeline provided in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' places [[Han Solo]]{{'s}} [[Kessel Run]] nine [[Standard year|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. As that film takes place in [[19 BBY]], we can deduce that the mission to [[Kessel]] and the subsequent Kessel Run took place in [[10 BBY]]. [[Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca]], [[Qi'ra]], [[Tobias Beckett]], and the droid [[L3-37]] disrupted a Pyke Syndicate [[spice]] [[mining]] operation on [[Kessel]] during a [[Raid on Kessel|mission]] to acquire [[coaxium]] for the [[Crimson Dawn]] [[crime lord]] [[Dryden Vos]]. While fleeing Imperial forces, Solo managed to make the [[Kessel Run]] aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' in less than thirteen [[parsec]]s, beating previous records. Later, Solo, Qi'ra, and Chewbacca joined forces with [[Enfys Nest]]'s [[Cloud-Riders]] to [[Showdown on Savareen|defeat]] Vos' Pyke Syndicate forces on [[Savareen]]. Vos and Beckett also met their ends at the hands of Qi'ra and Solo respectively.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' At some point, Anaxes was [[Destruction of Anaxes|destroyed]] in a cataclysmic event. The planet was reduced to an [[asteroid field]] which included the former [[Republic Military]] base [[Fort Anaxes]]. Fort Anaxes was situated on the asteroid [[PM-1203]].{{Databank|fort-anaxes|Fort Anaxes}} Eventually, Fort Anaxes was used as a supply station for members of the rebellion.{{Rebels|Out of Darkness}} The [[4 BBY|following year]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of {{Rebels|Empire Day (episode)}} in [[4 BBY]]. As this event appear in {{Rebels|Empire Day (episode)}}, it takes place in 4 BBY. the [[Great Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his [[Padawan|apprentice]] [[Ezra Bridger]] were involved in a [[Rescue of Tseebo|skirmish]] with [[the Grand Inquisitor]] at PM-1203.{{Rebels|Gathering Forces}} ===Galactic Civil War=== {{Quote|The Empire has let the Outer Rim run wild for too long, Sutha. The Rodian was overly disruptive. If there are to be… other active powers, they should be ones with whom the Empire has an understanding.|Darth Vader|[[Darth Vader (2015) 7|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 7]]}} During the Imperial Era, several rebel cells emerged throughout the Outer Rim, including [[Hera Syndulla]]'s [[Spectres]], the [[Phoenix Cell]],{{Rebels|Fire Across the Galaxy}} and [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]]'s [[Massassi Group]].{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} Following the suppression of the [[Batonn insurgency]], [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] was tasked with eliminating rebel forces in the [[Lothal sector]].''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' Despite inflicting heavy casualties on rebel forces during the [[Battle of Atollon]], the Spectres and [[Lothal resistance group]] succeeded in [[Liberation of Lothal|liberating]] the planet Lothal from Imperial rule.{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}} By [[2 BBY]], various rebel cells had coalesced into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] under the leadership of [[Mon Mothma]] in response to the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. This rebel network posed a major threat to Empire and established bases on the worlds of [[Dantooine]] [[Great Temple|and]] [[Yavin 4]]. The Rebellion won its first victory against the Galactic Empire{{Film|IV}} at the [[Battle of Scarif]], which resulted in the theft of the [[Death Star plans]].''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' After the Emperor [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|dissolved]] of the [[Imperial Senate]], regional governors were given direct control over their territories. [[Luke Skywalker]], who hailed from [[Tatooine]], ultimately destroyed the Empire's [[Superweapon|planet-killing]] [[battle station]] at the [[Battle of Yavin]]. The Death Star's destruction kicked off a time of unrest[[Darth Vader (2015) 12|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 12]] and an increase in those who doubted Imperial rule.[[Darth Vader Annual 1|''Darth Vader Annual'' 1]] As such, the recently-promoted [[Grand General]] [[Cassio Tagge]] and Vader moved to keep the Empire secure,[[Darth Vader (2015) 2|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 2]] with Vader promising the Hutt [[Sutha]] that the Empire was no longer interested in allowing the Outer Rim to run wild. Having just [[First attack on the Son-tuul Pride|crippled]] the [[Son-tuul]] syndicate because it was overly disruptive, Vader informed Sutha that the only active powers in the Outer Rim should be those like the Hutts, as they had an understanding with the Empire. The Outer Rim Territories became embroiled in the [[Galactic Civil War]], with the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet]] dispersed across the region and the Empire fortifying the border of the Mid Rim against the lawlessness of the outlying systems.''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' Due to its distance from the Core, unauthorized holofeeds operated in abundance in the Outer Rim, owing in part to the Empire's tentative control of the region. During this time, the Empire launched a crackdown on the Outer Rim to eliminate criminal syndicates save for those allied with the Empire, such as the Hutts, who [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] had negotiated with for resources. This included an attack on the Cymorah sydicate which had been stealing from the Empire. Vader led forces to attack a station, which resulted in its destruction.[[Darth Vader (2015) 2|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 2]] The Empire's attack on the Son-tuul Pride resulted in the seizure of its credit hoards and the death of the leader, [[Yonak's father]].[[Darth Vader (2015) 7|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 7]] The Son-tuul-Pride would later be briefly reorganized under [[0-0-0]] before being dissolved after the Empire launched another [[Second attack on the Son-tuul Pride|attack]] led by Lieutenant-Inspector [[Magna Tolvan]] that decimated them.[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 19|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 19]] Many of the Empire's funding was going towards the construction of Super Star Destroyers. Some of it also helped enrich the Hutts although this was simply a side effect.[[Darth Vader (2015) 9|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 9]] A lot of crime events took place in the Anthan system which led to fighting between criminals and the Empire. After the Son-tuul robbery Vader and Thanoth worked there to find those responsible, although Vader was secretly responsible so he worked to cover it up. On [[Anthan Prime]] there was a droid fighting den and the Empire raided it where Vader and Inspector [[Thanoth]] captured Doowan who gave them the location the Dragons den on Anthan 13 where Vader killed him.[[Darth Vader (2015) 10|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 10]] They used his data to find the Ante who was a major figure who sold information. Vader and Thanoth led a raid which resulted in the death of the Ante.[[Darth Vader (2015) 11|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 11]] Vader and Thanoth later attacked a rebel group on Anthan 1 and destroyed them.[[Darth Vader (2015) 12|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 12]] After the [[Mid Rim Retreat]], the Empire discovered the Rebellion's [[Echo Base|new base]] on [[Hoth]], destroying it in the [[Battle of Hoth]]{{Film|V}} and splintering the Rebellion into fragments spread across the Outer Rim. Following [[Operation Ringbreaker]], roughly six [[Standard month|months]] after the Battle of Hoth, [[Operation Yellow Moon]] allowed the scattered Rebel [[Fleet]] to [[Staging area|converge]] over Sullust to strike on the Empire's new [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star]] under construction over [[Endor]]. Its destruction in the [[Battle of Endor]], as well as the deaths of the Emperor and Darth Vader,{{Film|VI}} saw the fragmentation of Imperial authority, resulting in the gradual retreat of Imperial dominion from the Outer Rim. ===New Republic Era=== ====Ending the war==== {{Quote|We must be cautious. Inroads to the Outer Rim are slow.|Mon Mothma|}} The [[New Republic]], the government formed by the Rebel Alliance, admitted [[Akiva]] as the first Outer Rim world to formally join the Republic in the months after Endor. The [[Criigo insurrection]] and [[battle above Desevro]] both occurred in the Outer Rim.''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]'' After the Battle of Endor, the Alliance had feared the Empire would heavily cement itself in the Outer Rim.''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'' However, by [[5 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]]. the Empire had lost control of much of the Outer Rim, with the [[Exterior]] the only sector that really remained under its control. [[Zhadalene]], [[Korrus]], and [[Belladoon]] also remained under Imperial control. Many crime groups took advantage of this chaos to rise. Under the orders of [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Gallius Rax]], the Empire nationalized the Imperial weapons and vehicular [[Factory|factories]] there for the war effort. In coordination with Imperial fleets hidden in the [[Vulpinus Nebula]], the [[Almagest]], the [[Recluse's Nebula]], the [[Queluhan Nebula]], the [[Ro-Loo Triangle]], and the [[Inamorata]], Rax planned to use the three Outer Rim holdouts as a cord to strangle the New Republic.''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' Shortly before the [[Battle of Jakku]], [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] reported that Tatooine and [[Horuz]] were in the thrall of some Imperial remnant, criminal syndicates or [[gangster]]s. The [[Red Key Raiders]] tried to take over Tatooine but were [[Skirmish in Freetown|opposed]] by [[Cobb Vanth]], the elusive [[Mayor]] and [[Sheriff]] of [[Freetown]].''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' The Empire made a final attempt at a counter-offensive one year after Endor,''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' but was defeated at the Battle of [[Jakku]] by the New Republic.''[[Lost Stars]]'' The Empire was pushed back to a handful of sectors in the fringe of the Outer Rim, and although they only contained a small fraction of the galaxy's population and industrial base, they were nevertheless a heavily fortified final redoubt. As a result, the New Republic deemed that they posed too minor of a threat to justify the high cost in life that liberating them would require, and the Empire surrendered to the New Republic and signed a [[Galactic Concordance|treaty]] ending the war. The Republic then began arriving in the remaining Imperial sectors to announce the signing of the treaty. ====Uncertain times==== After the Battle of Jakku, the Outer Rim was very lawless as the New Republic did not do much to control it. Due to this it was common a place for Imperial remnants like Moff [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]] to hide, with [[Nevarro Imperial base|bases]] on planets like [[Nevarro]].{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 12: The Siege}} The world of Tatooine remained a hotbed for crime{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} but did see some changes, such as the withdraw of the Bounty Hunter's Guild. The Mos Eisley cantina,{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 5: The Gunslinger}} formerly known for not allowing droids, now featured droid employees. Ousting the [[Pyke Syndicate]] from the world with the [[Battle of Mos Espa]], former bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]] established his own [[Fett gotra|criminal empire]] on Tatooine with the goal of ruling by respect.{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} In [[28 ABY]],{{Twitter|DelReyStarWars|status/652893780236988420|[[Del Rey]]|quote=So excited to have @claudiagray writing a #StarWars novel with us. SW: New Republic: Bloodline coming 2016. Set 6 years before TFA.|archivefile=File:New Republic Bloodline Twitter Post.jpg}} The tweet in question states that the events of ''Bloodline'' take place six [[Standard year|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that ''The Force Awakens'' takes place in the year [[34 ABY]], so simple math shows that ''Bloodline'' takes place in [[28 ABY]]. New Republic member worlds included [[Arkanis]] and [[Daxam IV]], which were aligned with the [[Centrists|Centrist]] faction in the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] on [[Hosnian Prime]]. The Outer Rim planet Ryloth chose not to join the new galactic government. The planet [[Pamarthe]] was known for producing [[pilot]]s. ====First Order beginnings==== The New Republic took steps to control organized crime by introducing new financial regulations and patrolling the major shipping lines. However, organized crime later returned to the [[Gaulus sector]] and adversely affected the economy of Ryloth due to the indecisiveness of the Galactic Senate. One major crime syndicate was the [[Nikto]] crime lord [[Rinnrivin Di]]'s [[Rinnrivin Di's cartel|cartel]], which was [[Rinnrivin's headquarters|based]] on Bastatha. Rinnrivin's smuggling activities took a toll on Ryloth's economy and precipitated a New Republic senatorial [[Mission to Bastatha|investigation]] led by Organa and [[Ransolm Casterfo]]. In truth, Rinnrivin's cartel was a criminal front organization set up by several Centrist senators including [[Lady]] [[Carise Sindian]] to bankroll the [[Amaxine warriors (New Republic Era)|Amaxine warriors]] and the [[First Order]]'s [[First Order Navy|fleet]]. The planet Daxam IV was the [[Amaxine warriors' camp|site]] of an Amaxine base which housed a thousand Amaxine warriors. The Amaxines were a militia that was led by former [[Imperial officer]]s like [[Arliz Hadrassian]], who admired the Old Empire and sought to overthrow the New Republic. The organization was largely destroyed when an [[Mission to Sibensko|explosion]] destroyed their main base on the [[Expansion Region]] world of [[Sibensko]]. The First Order formed around a string of industrialized worlds, which stretched from [[Bastion]] to the planet [[Yaga Minor]].''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' During the [[Cold War]], the planet [[D'Qar]] in the [[Ileenium system]] hosted the [[Resistance]]'s [[Resistance base|base of operations]]. Shortly before the [[attack on Tuanul]], the First Order operated a mining [[Pressy's Tumble refinery complex|operation]] in [[Pressy's Tumble]], an artificial asteroid field in the [[Pressylla system]]. The former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and his [[commanding officer]] [[Captain]] [[Phasma]] took part in suppressing a [[Strike at Pressy's Tumble|strike]] at Pressy's Tumble.''[[Before the Awakening]]'' ===Rise of the First Order=== {{Quote|You see, Batuu, the entire outer rim really, is lawless. However, the Resistance [[Battle of Starkiller Base|destroyed]] Starkiller Base before it could fire its [[superlaser]].{{Film|VII}} Before the Resistance could complete their [[Battle of D'Qar|evacuation]] of D'Qar, they were attacked by the First Order Navy. Despite destroying a [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]], the Resistance lost several [[bomber]]s and [[starfighter]]s. Fleeing through hyperspace, they were [[Battle of Oetchi|pursued]] by the First Order Navy including [[Supreme Leader]] [[Snoke]]'s [[flagship]] ''[[Supremacy]]'', which was equipped with a [[hyperspace tracker]]. The Resistance operatives Finn and [[Rose Tico]] traveled to the planet [[Cantonica]] to recruit the [[Master Codebreaker]] to disable the First Order's hyperspace tracker. However, their [[Mission to Canto Bight|mission]] went awry, and they were only able to recruit the criminal [[slicer]] [[DJ]].{{Film|VIII}} After abandoning the Resistance flagship [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']], the Resistance evacuated in [[U-55 orbital loadlifter]]s to the planet [[Crait]]. However, the Resistance were betrayed by DJ, who revealed the Resistance's plans to the First Order. Despite sustaining heavy casualties, five of the Resistance loadlifters managed to regroup on Crait due to [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] ramming the ''Supremacy'' with the ''Raddus''. After killing Snoke, [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] claimed the mantle of Supreme Leader and led an [[Battle of Crait|assault]] against the Resistance on Crait. However, the Resistance escaped offworld due to Luke Skywalker's final stand with Ren. By [[35 ABY]],{{FilmDate|IX}} As the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] appears in ''The Rise of Skywalker'', it must have been estlablished by 35 ABY. the Resistance had established a [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|new base]] on the Outer Rim world of [[Ajan Kloss]]. That same year, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren led a [[Mission to Mustafar (First Order)|raid]] against [[Alazmec of Winsit|Alazmec colonists]] on the volcanic world of Mustafar in order to obtain a [[Sith wayfinder]], which led him to the hidden Sith world of [[Exegol]] where he formed an alliance with the resurrected Darth Sidious, who had ruled the First Order from behind the scenes through his puppet Snoke. The Sith Lord offered Ren the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]], the [[Final Order]], in return for hunting down his granddaughter, Rey.{{Film|IX}} During their quest for the second Sith wayfinder, [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], Finn, [[Poe Dameron|Poe]], Chewbacca, [[C-3PO]], [[BB-8]], and [[D-O]] traveled to the moon [[Kef Bir]] in the [[Endor system]], which was the site of the [[Death Star ruins]]. They also encountered members of the First Order stormtrooper unit [[Company 77]] led by [[Jannah]], who had deserted after refusing to shoot civilians. Though Kylo Ren destroyed the second Sith wayfinder during a [[Mission to Kef Bir|duel]] at the Death Star ruins, his mother Princess Leia gave her life to bring him back to the light side. After being healed by Rey and communing with a memory of his later father, Han Solo, Ren embraced his former identity of Ben Solo and rejected the dark side. Following the death of General Organa, Ajan Kloss served as a staging point for a Resistance [[Battle of Exegol|assault]] on the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]] on Exegol. After the defeat of Sidious, uprisings broke out against the First Order on the Outer Rim worlds of Bespin and Endor. Later, Rey, who had renounced her [[Palpatine family|Sith lineage]] and embraced the [[Skywalker family]], traveled to the [[Lars homestead]] on Tatooine where she buried the [[Skywalker lightsaber|Skywalker]] and [[Leia's lightsaber]]s. ==Government== ===Overview=== {{Quote|The Outer Rim is a lawless place. It is a haven for smugglers, cartels, syndicates, and all kinds of scum and villainy.|[[Jennica Pierce]]|''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''}} Due to its distance from the Core Worlds, the Outer Rim lacked a stable, central authority to maintain order across the vast expanses of [[Realspace|space]] in the region throughout its history. By the High Republic Era, it was considered a haven for all who wanted to avoid Republic law, becoming a region filled with anti-Republic individuals even as Chancellor Lina Soh wanted to bring the Republic into it. Numerous crime families such as the [[Hutt Clan]] and the Pyke Syndicate{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}} operated with impunity in the region, with slavery being common despite a Republic ban on its practice. As a result, many planets remained neutral and unaligned during the era of the Republic, such as [[Dathomir]],{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}} [[Nal Hutta]],''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and [[Zygerria]].[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] Mandalore was nominally associated with the Galactic Republic, but was not part of it.{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}} The Fett Gotra was established as a new type of crime family focused on respect instead of fear. ===Political divisions=== {{Quote|You don't survive in the Outer Rim by being stupid!|[[Pirate King]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]]|{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}}} The differing political factions of the Outer Rim Territories included: *The [[Corporate Sector Authority]]—a governmental body of the [[Corporate Sector]],''[[Shadow of the Sith]]'' a [[sector]] described as a "fiefdom" where corporate entities were given free reign to govern their own territory.''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' *The [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]]—a dominion ruled by the [[Zygerrian]] species. Operating from their capital world of [[Zygerria]], they upheld a vast slavery-based economy that lasted for thousands of years. This system endured until the [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] outlawed slavery and the [[Jedi Order]] intervened, launching a campaign that dismantled the slaving network and left the empire in ruins.{{Databank|zygerrian|Zygerrian}} *The [[First Order]]—an [[Dictatorship|autocratic]] [[First Order High Command|militaristic state]] formed from a remnant of the [[Galactic Empire]]—the New Republic Centrists''[[The Last Jedi: Bomber Command]]''—that had territory in the Outer Rim Territories. *The [[Regency Worlds]]—an autocratic government based on its throneworld of [[Arkanis]], which was also the [[capital]] of the eponymous [[Arkanis sector|sector]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], Empress [[Leeya]] allied the Regency Worlds with the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] and benefited from moderate Imperial taxation *The [[Quintad]]—also referred to as the Eriadu High Council,[[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 10|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 10]] was a governing body composed of the five ruling families of [[Eriadu]], including the influential [[Tarkin family]]. During the High Republic Era, when Eriadu was [[Nihil conflict|engulfed]] by the [[Nihil]] [[Occlusion Zone]], the Quintad assembled in response to the crisis.[[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 9|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 9]] *The [[Stalgasin hive]]—the largest of the hives on the planet Geonosis.''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' During the late years of the Galactic Republic [[Queen]] [[Karina the Great]] was the queen of the hive, though [[Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser]] ran the hive in her name.{{HelmetCollectionCite|31|Databank A-Z}} *The [[Serenno government|goverment]] of [[Serenno]]—an elective monarchy that ruled the [[Serenno system]] and its human population, the [[Serennian]]s.''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' *The [[Ryloth government|government]] of [[Ryloth]]—a [[planet]]ary [[Politics|government]] of the [[near-human]] [[Twi'lek]] [[species]] that did not join the [[New Republic]] after the [[Galactic Civil War]] and instead remained independent.[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] *The [[Mon Calamari monarchy]]—the [[planet]]ary government of [[Mon Cala]]. After a [[Quarren–Mon Calamari War|prolonged conflict]] between the [[Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren]], peace was ultimately established through the efforts of the monarchy and the [[Jedi]], resulting in, the formation of the [[Calamari Council]]—a governing body composed of representatives from both species.{{EncyclopediaCite|Mustafar and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} *The [[Lothal's government|goverment of Lothal]]—a political entity based in the [[Lothal sector]]. It existed before the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise of the Galactic Empire]], continued through the Empire's reign, and remained active during the [[New Republic Era|era of the New Republic]].{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}} *The [[Eirami government]]—the [[Monarchy|monarchial]] government that ruled the [[planet]] [[Eiram]], led by the [[E'ronoh royal family|Eiram royal family]], during the [[High Republic Era]]. *The [[Hetzalian government]]—the political entity of the [[Hetzal system]], headed by an individual who held the title of [[Minister]]. The government also had a [[Hetzal's security division|security division]], [[Counselor]]s who advised the minister, and a [[Ministry of Technology]]. The Hetzalian government was a constituent part of the [[Galactic Republic]]. *The [[Ab Dalisian government]]—a planetary government of the planet [[Ab Dalis]]. It served the interests of powerful corporations owned by oligarchs and trillionaires that operated on the world for generations. As a result, the government became deeply corrupt and largely ineffective. *The [[Pastoria kingdom]] —a monarchy that maintained authority on the [[planet]] [[Pastoria]]. During the [[Cold War]] it was led by [[King]] [[Siroc]].[[Poe Dameron 29|''Poe Dameron'' 29]] *The [[Noble Court]]—an [[Noble|aristocracy]] of the [[Nothoiin (species)|Nothoiin]] [[species]] in the [[Anoat sector]], which had existed since before the rise of the [[Galactic Republic]]. It was almost [[Subjugation of the Anoat sector|eradicated]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] and became a government in exile in the form of a secret society. *The [[Utapaun Committee]]—the planetary government of [[Utapau]].''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' *The [[Plazir-15's government|goverment of Plazir-15]]—ruled the independent sovereign state of Plazir-15. Following [[Galactic Concordance|the fall of the Empire]], the [[The Duchess|Duchess]]—head of the [[Royal family of Plazir-15|royal family]]—and her partner, [[Bombardier (individual)|Captain Bombardier]], established a new charter to redefine the governance of Plazir-15. This charter transformed the planet into an elective monarchy, with direct democracy serving as the main mechanism for both decision-making and elections. After its adoption, the citizens of Plazir-15 elected the Duchess and Bombardier as co-heads of state.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}} ==Astrography== The Outer Rim was home to the section of the galaxy known as the [[Tingel Arm]].''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' The astronomical object of [[X3-299-11]] sat beyond the Outer Rim and was home to a [[Unidentified temple (X3-299-11)|ancient temple]], where a [[Shadowfang Beast]] from the days of the [[Hundred-Year Darkness]] resided during the Imperial Era.[[Doctor Aphra Annual 2|''Doctor Aphra Annual'' 2]] Parts of the Outer Rim overlapped with the [[Western Reaches]].''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' places [[Mustafar]] in the [[Western Reaches]].
